about: Nathan's answers to the hull review (data/hull-review.md). 'groups' apply to every unclear hull matching the pattern; 'decisions' answer single hulls, keyed ERA/hull_id, and win over everything else. 'escort' makes a hull a variant on its carrier's page (from DRONE_SetupHostClass); 'merge' collapses hulls of the same era, faction and name into one entry with variants; 'variantOf' + 'kind' attach a hull to another hull's page. 'showOnlyOn' {month, day} limits when the app shows the entry (and its variants).

groups.note: The numbered Construction Bees (Type 1b to 4b) exist only for the mod's scripts and work the same as the first, so they're left out rather than shown as variants.
Yes; one entry per race and era. Many share a HOD (often the race's Dilithium Miner), so reuse that render.
Yes; on the carrier's page. Drones sharing a model collapse into one escort.

TOS/fed_TES_flagship.note: The I.S.S. October Revolution is the mod's unused Terran flagship (its swap is switched off), so it's shown only on 7 November, the anniversary of the October Revolution it's named after (25 October 1917 in the Julian calendar Russia then used).
